scope: durable source approval, discovery dispatch state, sanitized collection, and admin controls
claims: Discovery can be requested only with durable storage, a separate active source approval, and an available immutable worker configuration.
Queued, running, failed, and completed outcomes remain attached to the intake.
Dispatcher failures persist only bounded error codes and never exception detail.
A matching sanitized receipt advances the existing catalog review journey.
non_claims: The default runtime does not have an enabled dispatcher.
No worker, proxy, or collector has been deployed to a cluster.
Certification, approval, publication, and provisioning remain disabled.
